schedule.scheduleNotes: DRAFT counter-proposal schedule (not for publication). Structure: Days 1–4 Group C/D (prelims+finals) and all Junior Nationals Open events; Days 5–8 Group A/B only. Rules: one event per age group/gender per day (two rounds of the same event allowed); 3m and platform never on consecutive days for any group; A/B semifinal the day after prelims; springboard semis 36 (split 18/18), platform semis 24; prelims ≤50 springboard/≤38 platform incl. 2 Open-earned spots. Pace per 2025 JN planning: 30 s/dive springboard, 36 s/dive platform. Field sizes projected from real 2026 results under the proportional model (12-6-1). Facility: Marguerite Aquatic Complex (4×1m, 2×3m, 5/7.5/10m). Dates provisional within Jul 26–Aug 8, 2027.
